'''Mage Guards''' are [[NPCs]] that appear in certain entry points of the {{zone|Cathedral}} during the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]].

== Quests ==
Ten '''Mage Guards''' appear in {{Zone|Cathedral}} during the [[Barbarian Faction]] quest, when the player is instructed to steal research from there.
